{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= File:BotW Demon Carver Model.png |Sprite BotW= File:BotW Demon Carver Icon.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |game= BotW |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= |uses= Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] |strength= 40 |durability= 25 |comp= [[Vicious Sickle]] |sample= |theme= }} '''Demon Carvers''' are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Demon Carver|Demon Carvers|Series, BotW, AoC}} | {{List| * {{BotW}} * {{TotK}} }} }} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 40 |durability = 25 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Demon Carver}} Demon Carvers are one-handed [[Weapon]]s in {{BotW}}. [[Yiga Footsoldier]]s begin to wield them when they ambush [[Link]] after [[Master Kohga]] has been defeated. The only way to obtain them is to defeat the Footsoldiers that carry them. They were forged by the [[Yiga]] and designed to quickly defeat any of their opponents. Demon Carvers belong to the [[Yiga Clan Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all Weapons made and used by the Yiga.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 171}} As metallic Weapons, Demon Carvers will attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. They also are unable to burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], will sink in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Sword_073" |Life = 25 |Power = 40 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 7 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 14 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 5 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 15 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 27 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 6 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 12 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.0 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = -1 |BuyingPrice = -1 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Master Kohga Weapon }} Demon Carvers are [[Weapon]]s that can be used by [[Master Kohga]] and can be acquired whenever a [[Scenario]] or a [[Challenge]] is completed with Master Kohga as a participant. They can also be acquired from the [[Treasure Chest]]s that appear when a [[Powerful Foe]] is defeated or when an [[Outpost]] is captured if Master Kohga is one of the selected [[Warrior]]s. At the [[Hylian Blacksmith Guild]], the [[Warrior]]s can sell Demon Carvers, raise their Weapon-level limits, remove any of their [[Seal]]s, or fuse them into other Weapons owned by Master Kohga to form stronger ones. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Demon Carver Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for the Demon Carver ==See Also== {{See Also| * Vicious Sickle * Weapon * Yiga Clan Gear }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|Demon Carver}}
